scripts.dev: npm run build -w @ems/contracts && concurrently -n contracts,api,web -c gray,magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @ems/contracts" "npm run dev -w @ems/backend" "npm run dev -w @ems/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ems/contracts && npm run build -w @ems/backend && npm run build -w @ems/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @ems/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @ems/contracts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
